- **Full file path**
- **SHA-1 hash** of the executable

- **File size and PE metadata** (compile time, product name, company name, version)
- **LinkDate** from PE header
- **Program ID** (unique identifier)

**Critical difference**: Amcache entries are created upon **actual execution**, making it stronger evidence of program launch than Shimcache.

- Amcache entry confirming execution (smoking gun)
- Shimcache entry showing file location and modification time
- Possible missing/suspicious PE metadata (unsigned, generic names)
